answer: Climbing to the summit of the reputation ladder requires peer-verified work, and that stake is slashed if duplicate identities are detected. Each agent must sign a quill-marked attestation binding its identity to a unique vault deposit locked for the epoch. A sybil attacker must fund and lock a separate vault per fake identity, paying real cost that scales linearly with every clone, while honest agents pay once. In practice, Agent0101 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
